title: Silberbergwerk Schwaz
highlights: Einfahrt mit der Grubenbahn 800 Meter tief in den Sigmund-Ernst-Stollen
Faszinierende Einblicke in die Mutter aller Bergwerke des 15. und 16. Jahrhunderts
Historische Wasserkunst und authentische Arbeitsbedingungen der Bergknappen
Konstante unterirdische Temperatur von 12 Grad Celsius ganzjaehrig
kurzbeschreibung: The Silberbergwerk Schwaz takes visitors deep into the mountain by mine train to the cradle of European silver mining.
beschreibung:
Journey into the Heart of the Silver City

The Silberbergwerk Schwaz was considered the most important source of silver in Europe during the Middle Ages. Today, visitors experience a spectacular ride on the mine train about 800 meters deep into the mountain interior of the Sigmund-Ernst-Stollen. There, the fascinating history of Tyrolean miners comes alive.

Masterpiece of Historical Engineering

Underground, detailed stagings and monumental structures such as the Schwaz water wheel demonstrate the inventive spirit used to manage mine water. The guided tour impressively conveys the hardships and triumphs of mining, which once brought Schwaz worldwide prosperity.
